meta.name: debrief
meta.description: Turn meeting notes or a transcript into sourced decisions, changes and next actions. Use after a customer conversation; review consequential record updates before saving.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把会议记录或录音转成有据可查的决策、变更和下一步行动
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次客户沟通后都要手动把笔记整理成结论和待办
copy.tagline_en: Turn meeting notes or a transcript into sourced decisions and next actions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you end customer calls with raw notes that still need to become decisions and tasks

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把会议记录或转录稿整理成带出处的决定、变更和下一步行动。保存重要的记录更新前,它会先让你确认。
howto.when: 客户对话结束后,你交出会议记录或转录稿时触发;被 @fde 调用时沿用其当前上下文,不重新开始设置或提问。

say.text: 把这份客户会议转录稿整理成决定、变更和下一步行动
say.note: 产出带出处的草稿,保存前先等你确认

say.text: 这些笔记里哪些决定需要改动记录?列出来,先别保存
say.note: 会区分实现、验证、部署与验收

say.text: 沿用 @fde 当前的上下文,继续处理这场客户对话
say.note: 不重新走设置和提问流程

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude turns your meeting notes or transcript into decisions, changes and next actions, each with sources. You review consequential record updates before anything is saved.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you hand over meeting notes or a transcript after a customer conversation. When called by @fde, it reuses that sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup.

say_en.text: Turn this customer call transcript into decisions, changes and next actions.
say_en.note: You get a sourced draft; saving waits for your review.

say_en.text: Which record updates do these notes imply? List them, don't save yet.
say_en.note: Keeps implementation, verification and acceptance separate.

say_en.text: Continue from @fde's current context for this customer conversation.
say_en.note: No setup or questions are restarted.
